reason: The README clearly describes a WeChat ClawBot/iLink integration that authenticates users, sends and receives messages, and optionally automates polling and replies, so external-services is the primary category.

summaries.zh: 通过微信 ClawBot/iLink API 提供扫码登录、状态查询、消息收取与发送，并可选启用后台轮询和自动回复。
summaries.en: Connects to the WeChat ClawBot/iLink API for QR-code login, status checks, message polling and sending, with optional background polling and automated replies.

capabilities: Connects to the WeChat ClawBot/iLink HTTP API
Supports QR-code login and stores an API token locally
Sends text messages and polls for incoming messages
Runs background polling and can trigger DSH sessions for automatic replies
Persists inbox and conversation state locally
